title: Georgia Small Estate Affidavit (2026): No Administration Necessary & the $15,000 Bank Rule
rank_math_title: Georgia Small Estate Affidavit (2026): No-Cap Petition
rank_math_description: Georgia has no dollar-based small estate affidavit: banks may pay up to $15,000 to family, and heirs can petition for no administration at any estate size.
pdf_outline: Route finder: will? -> probate; bank deposits <= $15,000 -> bank affidavit; heirs all agree + debts handled -> GPCSF 9; else administration
